findings.rationale: Accepted: one sentence added to D1 step 3 — pocket rule unchanged, suite draws the unreserved remainder, no re-derivation after the join.

Accepted: the supplement stays inside chain A after the panel; join is Promise.allSettled over chain A (panel→supplement) and chain B (full_suite); adapters return failure receipts, never throw; RED case pins the suite row surviving a throwing reviewPanel.

Accepted: the gate is the full_suite pre-station wall check (autopilot-engine.js:7842, 'campaign wall budget exhausted before verification', phase campaign_wall_budget, terminalized wall_expired since v2.36.71); nothing sums stations — overlap moves the suite's check to the panel's start instant. Sibling on wall expiry finishes within its own precomputed deadline and is journaled; RED pins no surviving seat process after terminalization.
Accepted: cache-hit control and pre-2-D journal replay control added as new cases in the overlap suite with RED notes; station_single_control named.

Accepted with a different mechanism: the write stays before the claim; a claim rejected in the same intake unlinks only the file this call created, so no claim-held-without-snapshot window exists. Digest verification recomputes over the fields the file carries against the file's own stored digest (every 2-B+ file has one; pre-2-C files digest without review_station per 2-C) — no new stored field.
Accepted: §8 Q2 closed as out of scope; §7 excludes any knob and any reducer change unconditionally; reducer row now says 'not touched; stop and re-plan if rows lack timestamps'.

Accepted: D2 edits no existing assertion; qc_panel_snapshot_drift is asserted only in the new suite against an EEXIST mismatch; panel-snap-drift, panel-snap-write, review_station_snapshot and the step-order fixture stay byte-identical. D1 RED comments record the observed base timestamps delta and the exact campaign_wall_budget block payload.
Accepted as spike text in D1 step 2: verify at base both adapters are async child-process backed and record the serial full_suite_seconds baseline before coding.
